audit.summary: Critical issues identified: 2 product images contain promotional overlays, pricing, and legal text that violate clean asset requirements for HTML5 ad generation. Logo asset verified as official SVG from byd.com domain. 4 product images are acceptable clean packshots. Brave retry queries recommended for regional-specific promotional imagery without watermarks.

findings.issue: Product image contains promotional overlay with Euro NCAP badge, pricing (299€/month), financing terms, warranty info, and legal footnotes. This embedded marketing copy and third-party certification badge violates clean asset requirements for modular HTML5 ad generation.
findings.fix_hint: Request clean product packshot of BYD SEAL U DM-i without promotional overlays from official BYD Italy site or media kit. Use site:byd.com/it and 'BYD SEAL U DM-i packshot senza testo promozionale' in Brave.

findings.issue: Product image contains promotional overlay with pricing (399€/month), financing details, Euro NCAP badge, and legal disclaimer text. Embedded pricing and certification marks prevent reuse in independent ad templates.
findings.fix_hint: Retrieve clean SEAL U packshot without promotional text overlay. Search: site:byd.com 'SEAL U packshot 2024' or 'BYD SEAL U exterior product image clean'.

findings.issue: SVG logo asset not verified against actual byd.com homepage header (vision API cannot preview SVG). Confirm this matches the official wordmark from the primary logo position on https://www.byd.com/fr/voitures-electriques/seal-u or https://www.byd.com/en/about-byd.
findings.fix_hint: Cross-verify logo.svg rendering against live byd.com site header. If uncertain, retry with: site:byd.com 'BYD logo svg official' or site:commons.wikimedia.org 'BYD logo 2022'.
